points.title: 酋长之子
points.description: 纳尔逊·曼德拉1918年7月18日出生于南非东开普省的姆维佐村，属于滕布人的王室家族。他的父亲是滕布部落的首领，母亲是父亲的第三位妻子。按照传统，曼德拉应该继承酋长之位，但父亲在他9岁时去世后，由摄政王琼图成为他的监护人。这段经历让曼德拉从小接触到了非洲传统价值观和殖民统治的双重影响，为他后来的政治理念奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Nelson Mandela was born on July 18, 1918, in Mvezo, a village in the Eastern Cape of South Africa, into the royal family of the Thembu people. His father was a chief of the Thembu people, and his mother was his third wife. Traditionally, Mandela was destined to become a chief, but after his father's death when he was nine years old, he was placed under the guardianship of Jongintaba Dalindyebo, the regent. This early exposure to both African traditional values and colonial rule profoundly influenced his later political philosophy.

points.title: 觉醒之路
points.description: 1941年，曼德拉逃离了由摄政王安排的婚姻，来到约翰内斯堡。在这里，他亲眼目睹了种族隔离制度下黑人所遭受的歧视和压迫。他先后在威特沃特斯兰德大学学习法律，结识了非洲人国民大会(ANC)的成员，包括沃尔特·西苏鲁等激进政治家。这段经历使他从一个部落青年转变为具有政治意识的反种族隔离活动家，并最终加入了非洲人国民大会。
points.descriptionEn: In 1941, Mandela fled from an arranged marriage arranged by the regent and came to Johannesburg. Here, he witnessed firsthand the discrimination and oppression faced by Black people under the apartheid system. He studied law at the University of the Witwatersrand, where he met members of the African National Congress (ANC), including radical politicians like Walter Sisulu. This period transformed him from a tribal youth into a politically conscious anti-apartheid activist, eventually leading him to join the ANC.

points.title: 抗争先锋
points.description: 1944年，曼德拉与奥利弗·坦博共同创立了非洲人国民大会青年联盟，主张采取更激进的手段反对种族隔离政策。1952年，他与坦博开设了南非第一家黑人律师事务所，为受压迫的黑人提供法律援助。1955年，他参与了《自由宪章》的起草，该文件成为反种族斗争的纲领性文件。随着政府镇压加剧，曼德拉逐渐转向非暴力抵抗，但最终在1961年协助创建了ANC的军事翼'民族之矛'，标志着他开始支持武装斗争。
points.descriptionEn: In 1944, Mandela co-founded the ANC Youth League with Oliver Tambo, advocating for more aggressive methods against apartheid policies. In 1952, he and Tambo opened South Africa's first Black law firm, providing legal assistance to oppressed Black people. In 1955, he helped draft the Freedom Charter, which became a foundational document of the anti-apartheid struggle. As government repression intensified, Mandela initially advocated for nonviolent resistance but eventually helped create the ANC's military wing, Umkhonto we Sizwe, in 1961, marking his shift toward supporting armed struggle.

points.title: 铁窗岁月
points.description: 1962年8月，曼德拉因煽动罢工和非法离开南非被捕，被判5年监禁。1964年，他在里沃尼亚审判中被判处终身监禁，主要罪名包括阴谋推翻政府。他在罗本岛监狱度过了18年，随后在波尔斯穆尔监狱和维克多·维尔斯特监狱服刑。在狱中，他拒绝有条件释放，坚持要求所有南非人平等的权利。这段漫长的监禁岁月使他成为国际反种族隔离运动的象征，同时也让他有时间反思和制定未来的政治策略，为出狱后的和解政策奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In August 1962, Mandela was arrested for inciting strikes and leaving South Africa illegally, sentenced to 5 years imprisonment. In 1964, he was sentenced to life imprisonment at the Rivonia Trial, primarily for conspiring to overthrow the government. He spent 18 years on Robben Island, followed by time at Pollsmoor Prison and Victor Verster Prison. During his imprisonment, he refused conditional release, insisting on equal rights for all South Africans. This long period of incarceration made him an international symbol of the anti-apartheid movement and allowed him time to reflect and develop political strategies that would form the basis of his reconciliation policies after release.

points.title: 和解领袖
points.description: 1990年2月11日，在国内外压力下，南非总统德克勒克释放了曼德拉。出狱后，他领导非洲人国民大会与政府进行谈判，最终促成了种族隔离制度的终结。1993年，他与德克勒克共同获得诺贝尔和平奖。1994年4月，南非举行了首次多种族大选，曼德拉当选为南非第一位黑人总统。在他的领导下，南非建立了真相与和解委员会，以处理种族隔离时期的暴行，同时致力于种族和解与国家重建。他于1999年卸任，结束了5年的总统任期。
points.descriptionEn: On February 11, 1990, under domestic and international pressure, South African President F.W. de Klerk released Mandela. After his release, he led the ANC in negotiations with the government, ultimately leading to the end of apartheid. In 1993, he and de Klerk jointly received the Nobel Peace Prize. In April 1994, South Africa held its first multiracial elections, and Mandela was elected as the country's first Black president. Under his leadership, South Africa established the Truth and Reconciliation Commission to address atrocities committed during apartheid, while working toward racial reconciliation and national reconstruction. He stepped down after his five-year presidential term in 1999.

points.title: 和平使者
points.description: 卸任总统后，曼德拉继续致力于和平事业，担任'长者'组织的成员，该组织由全球知名领导人组成，致力于解决国际冲突。他积极推动艾滋病防治工作，成立了纳尔逊·曼德拉基金会。2004年，他因健康原因逐渐淡出公众视野，但仍然是全球最受尊敬的人物之一。2010年，他出席了南非世界杯开幕式，展示了他在国际上的影响力。2013年12月5日，曼德拉在约翰内斯堡家中去世，享年95岁，全球各国领导人出席了他的葬礼，彰显了他作为全球和平与和解象征的地位。
points.descriptionEn: After leaving the presidency, Mandela continued to work for peace as a member of 'The Elders,' an organization of global leaders dedicated to resolving international conflicts. He actively promoted HIV/AIDS awareness and established the Nelson Mandela Foundation. In 2004, he gradually withdrew from public life due to health issues but remained one of the world's most respected figures. In 2010, he attended the opening ceremony of the FIFA World Cup in South Africa, demonstrating his international influence. On December 5, 2013, Mandela died at his home in Johannesburg at the age of 95. Leaders from around the world attended his funeral, highlighting his status as a global symbol of peace and reconciliation.

supporter.zh: 曼德拉被广泛视为南非的国父和全球和平的象征。支持者赞扬他超越仇恨的宽恕精神，以及在种族隔离结束后推动种族和解的非凡领导力。他通过'真相与和解'而非报复的方式处理历史创伤，为世界提供了后冲突和解的典范。曼德拉的坚韧不拔，从27年监禁到成为总统的历程，激励了全球无数争取自由与正义的斗争。他的遗产不仅体现在南非的政治转型中，更成为人类尊严、宽容与和解的永恒象征。
supporter.en: Mandela is widely regarded as the father of South Africa and a global symbol of peace. Supporters praise his extraordinary spirit of forgiveness that transcended hatred and his remarkable leadership in promoting racial reconciliation after apartheid. His approach of 'truth and reconciliation' rather than retribution in addressing historical trauma provided a model for post-conflict resolution worldwide. Mandela's resilience, from 27 years in prison to becoming president, has inspired countless struggles for freedom and justice globally. His legacy is not only evident in South Africa's political transition but stands as an eternal symbol of human dignity, tolerance, and reconciliation.

critic.zh: 批评者指出曼德拉的政策存在局限性，特别是他领导的ANC政府未能有效解决南非的经济不平等问题，导致今日南非仍面临高失业率和贫富差距。有人批评他对周边国家威权政权的态度过于宽容，以及对艾滋病危机初期反应迟缓。此外，曼德拉在1990年代初期与ANC内部的激进派别关系紧张，被一些人批评为过于妥协。尽管如此，这些批评大多承认他在结束种族隔离制度方面的历史性贡献，只是质疑他未能完全实现建立一个'彩虹之国'的愿景。
critic.en: Critics point out limitations in Mandela's policies, particularly that the ANC government he led failed to effectively address economic inequality, leaving South Africa today with high unemployment and a wealth gap. Some criticize his overly tolerant attitude toward authoritarian regimes in neighboring countries and his slow initial response to the AIDS crisis. Additionally, Mandela had tense relations with more radical factions within the ANC in the early 1990s, with some accusing him of excessive compromise. Nevertheless, most critics acknowledge his historic contribution to ending apartheid while questioning his failure to fully realize the vision of a 'rainbow nation.'

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，曼德拉被复杂地定义为多重角色的结合体：既是革命家又是和解者，既是政治犯又是国家元首。历史学者强调他的政治实用主义，能够从武装斗争转向谈判桌，最终实现了权力的和平过渡。流行文化将他塑造为超越政治的道德偶像，他的形象经常与自由、尊严和宽恕等普世价值观联系在一起。曼德拉的遗产反映了后殖民时代政治转型的复杂性，他的故事既是一个国家转型的缩影，也是关于个人救赎与集体和解的普遍叙事。他的一生体现了政治理想与现实政治之间的张力，以及如何在历史关键时刻做出艰难但必要的妥协。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Mandela is complexly defined as a combination of multiple roles: revolutionary and reconciler, political prisoner and head of state. Historians emphasize his political pragmatism, able to shift from armed struggle to the negotiating table, ultimately achieving peaceful transition of power. Popular culture has shaped him into a moral icon transcending politics, with his image often linked to universal values like freedom, dignity, and forgiveness. Mandela's legacy reflects the complexities of political transition in the post-colonial era. His story is both a microcosm of a nation's transformation and a universal narrative about personal redemption and collective reconciliation. His life exemplifies the tension between political ideals and realpolitik, and how difficult but necessary compromises must be made at critical historical moments.

self.zh: 当我走出囚室，迈向通往自由的监狱大门时，我已经清楚，若不能把悲伤与怨恨留在身后，那么我其实仍在狱中。
self.en: When I walked out of my prison cell towards the gate of prison on that day, I knew that if I did not leave my bitterness and hatred behind, I would still be in prison.

others.zh: 曼德拉不是圣人，但他是一位伟大的政治家，他懂得何时坚持原则，何时妥协，以及何时宽恕。
others.en: Mandela was not a saint, but he was a great politician who knew when to stand firm, when to compromise, and when to forgive.
